title: AI Unboxing Video Maker for Online Sellers | AIVideosUGC
description: Create an AI unboxing video from one product photo: hands open the box, fold back the tissue, and reveal your item. Sized for TikTok and Shorts. Make yours now.
h1: Make an AI Unboxing Video of Your Product
lead: Show hands opening a box and lifting your product out, starting from one product photo. Describe the box and tissue you really ship with.

steps.d: Show the full item clearly. Describe the packaging and reveal in the next step.
Name the wrapping and what comes out first, such as a kraft box, cream tissue and a candle.
Describe only packaging you use, then review the result before sharing.

faq.q: Do I need a photo of my packaging?
faq.a: No. Upload the product itself and describe the box, wrapping and inserts you use.

faq.q: Will my logo appear on the box?
faq.a: Don't count on it. Logos and printed words can come out slightly wrong in AI video, so describe the box by color and finish, then add your logo on top in CapCut. Requests that use logos or trademarks you don't own may be refused.

faq.q: What length works for an unboxing video?
faq.a: Choose 6 seconds for a quick reveal, 10 to open the box and lift the item, or 15 to show several pieces.

faq.q: Can I make an unboxing video for a gift set or bundle?
faq.a: Yes. Upload a photo of the set and list what's inside, such as “three candles and a matchbox in a ribbon-tied box.” A few items usually come out cleaner than a crowded box.

overview.p: An unboxing clip follows a simple reveal: open the outer package, move aside one layer of wrapping, and show the item. Describe the materials and order you use so the preview stays close to the package customers receive.

steps.sourceAlt: Your product: a plain candle jar shown upright with its full shape visible.
steps.prompt: Use the uploaded photo as the product and keep its shape, color and label area exactly. At a bright home counter, adult hands open the plain kraft box, fold back tissue and lift the candle jar once. End with the jar centered beside the open box. Soft window light, calm unboxing style. Overhead medium framing with one slow push-in. Sound: lid lift, paper rustle and glass set-down; no music.
